title: zeltnera quitensis
intro: Zeltnera quitensis, commonly known as Quitensis penstemon or penstemon quitensis, is a flowering plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Zeltnera quitensis include its ability to support immune function and may have antimicrobial and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its composition and effects.
